lead: A `.nvst` case whose program ends non-zero must carry an `--EXPECTF-ERROR--` section even when it writes nothing to stderr.
body: `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs` is the one rule for the exit status, so an `exit(42)` case fails with `expected the run to succeed` and no hint that a section is missing. `%A` matches an empty stderr; `tests/conformance/error/a-limit-fatal-is-not-catchable.nvst` is the shape.
